description: Permanently delete a backup from an instance, freeing its space in the backup quota. This cannot be undone. A locked backup cannot be deleted; unlock it with update_backup first, but only once the user has agreed to that too. Call list_backups first and confirm with the user which backup, by name and date, they mean.

backup_id.description: Id of the backup to delete, from list_backups.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be deleted, naming the backup and its date and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: delete_backup
title: Delete Backup
